title: Get Paid
tagline: A project management tool that ensures freelancers get paid and clients get their jobs done
description:
The idea of this project is to use the concept of funds escrow to provide protection for consumers and service providers when working with large scale projects, such as renovation, website design, etc,... Common issues amongst these types of projects are: 

1, Work delivered by the service provider does not meet the expectations of the clients; 
2, Clients do not pay service providers for the work that they have completed given the work is completed according to the client's expectations. 

I believe setting up an escrow can resolve challenges faced by both sides. Clients must deposit the project's total cost into an escrow to provide comfort to the service provider that there are funds available for the project while clients have a mechanism to dispute or protect themselves having to pay for poor quality work from the service provider.
how_its_made:
NextJS and ShadCN are used to build the frontend and it connects to SQLite DB using Prisma ORM. As for the escrow, the idea is to use ERC-4626 standard, which has all the appropriate functionalities of deposits, disbursements and arbitration for this project.

The project is fairly straightforward and nothing hacky was done.
